text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик's bad health isn't improving.
Rumors
spread that I'm to blame for her
inability to run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unhappy with the situation, she resolves
to
change public opinion by training
more—only to
fall ill once more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I see this and realize that the cause of
her illness
is that she's trying too hard
for the sake of others.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
